# MuTracer

> MuTracer is a progressive, physically based path tracer for the browser. npm package `@meimu/mutracer`. WebGPU with a WebGL 2 fallback, OpenPBR 1.1 materials, BVH acceleration (JavaScript or TinyBVH WebAssembly), and denoising with a built-in JNLM filter or Intel Open Image Denoise (OIDN). MIT licensed.

## Essentials

- Install: `npm install @meimu/mutracer` (+ `three` for the Three.js helpers). ESM with TypeScript declarations; every option has TSDoc with its default.
- Scene: a plain object `{ meshes: Mesh[], lights: SceneLight[], background? }`. `new Mesh(geometry, material)` is placed with `mesh.transform` (column-major mat4, gl-matrix compatible).
- Initialization: optional `await renderer.init()` resolves backend, adapter and limits; `info` / `backend` are undefined before completion, `device` is WebGPU only, `samples` initially 0 ([API](docs/api.md)).
- Render loop: `const renderer = new Renderer({ canvas }); renderer.setSize(w, h);` then `renderer.render(scene, camera)` once per `requestAnimationFrame`. It accumulates up to `renderer.maxSamples` (default 2048) and returns a status.
- Statuses: `'preparing'`, `'compiling'`, `'converging'`, `'denoising'`, `'finished'`, `'error'`; `renderer.status` initially `'preparing'`. Intermediate denoising stays converging; denoising/finished describe the final image ([API](docs/api.md#status)).
- Updates: edit the scene in place; membership, transforms, references, lights and background are detected. Call `material.markUpdated()` after parameter edits, `texture.markUpdated()` after pixel edits, `geometry.markVerticesUpdated()` after vertex-only edits, and `geometry.markUpdated()` after index or `materialIndex` edits. For per-frame deformation set `geometry.dynamic = true`.
- Three.js: `const sync = new THREESceneSync(threeScene)`, then each frame `sync.update(); renderer.render(sync.scene, fromTHREECamera(threeCamera));` (`update()` returns void; Renderer detects edits). Use Three.js `needsUpdate` flags for buffer and texture pixel edits; material property edits need none. Supports MeshStandardMaterial, MeshPhysicalMaterial, MeshBasicMaterial, skinning, morph targets, InstancedMesh, and directional, point, spot, rect-area and ambient lights. Load glTF with Three.js `GLTFLoader` + `THREESceneSync`; calculate world matrices in Three.js or the host application.
- Materials: `new OpenPBRMaterial(params?)` with OpenPBR names (`baseColor`, `baseMetalness`, `specularRoughness`, `specularIor`, `transmissionWeight`, `coatWeight`, `subsurfaceWeight`, `fuzzWeight`, `thinFilmWeight`, `emissionLuminance`, ...). Colors are linear RGB; 8-bit textures are sRGB. `mapAlphaUsage`: `'opaque'` (default), `'alpha'`, `'transmission'`; material UV projection uses `uvProjectionScale` / `displacementUvProjectionScale` ([details](docs/materials.md)).
- Lights: parameter objects; analytic lights use `position` / `lookAt()` and rigid `transform` (local -Z emission, +X IES reference); `size` / `radius` set dimensions. `new EnvironmentLight({ map })`; see [lights](./docs/getting-started.md#lights).
- Backgrounds: omit to show the environment; `[r, g, b, a]` linear color (`[0,0,0,0]` = transparent canvas, pair with `material.shadowCatcher = true`); a `Texture`; or `{ type: 'GroundedSkybox', map, height, radius }`.
- Denoising: `await renderer.setDenoiser()` for JNLM (both backends, no download). `await renderer.setDenoiser({ type: 'oidn', model?: 'standard' | 'small' | 'cleanAuxLarge' })` for OIDN (WebGPU only; cleaner at 1–2 spp). `whileConverging: true` also denoises previews. With a denoiser, `maxSamples` 64–256 is usually enough.
- Depth of field: `camera.fStop = 2.8` (0 disables), `camera.focusDistance` along the view direction, `camera.metersPerUnit` for non-metre scenes; see [depth of field](./docs/getting-started.md#depth-of-field).
- Depth: after rendering, `await renderer.readDepthSamples({ x, y, size })` queries GPU pinhole depths for autofocus; see [depth sampling](docs/api.md#depth-sampling).
- Sampling: `renderer.samplingPattern` is `'sobol'` (default), `'zsobol'` (low spp without a denoiser) or `'random'`.
- Final stills: `await renderer.renderOfflineFrame(scene, camera, { samples })`, then `await renderer.toBlob()`. Linear HDR pixels: `await renderer.getRawOutput()`.
- BVH: automatic; optional `prebuildBVH(nextScene, { onProgress?, signal? })` returns void; diagnostics `bvh.lastBuild` holds statistics. Settings changes rebuild automatically. Listen to `progress` / `status` for loading UI ([BVH](docs/bvh.md)).

- Events: `renderer.on('sample' | 'status' | 'progress' | 'error' | 'denoised' | 'devicelost', listener)` returns unsubscribe; `lastError` only reflects the latest render's synchronous failure, async errors use `error` ([API](docs/api.md)).
- Geometry: `new Geometry({ position })` generates indices/normals; `vertexCount` / `triangleCount` are getters. `materialIndex` has itemSize 1 and one raw index per vertex (all triangle corners must match). See [geometry](./docs/getting-started.md#geometry-from-arrays).
- Spatial types: import `Vec2`, `Vec3` and `Mat4` from the main entry; matrices use 16 column-major elements. See [API](./docs/api.md).

## Three.js render loop

```ts
import { Renderer, THREESceneSync, fromTHREECamera } from '@meimu/mutracer';

const renderer = new Renderer({ canvas });
const sync = new THREESceneSync(threeScene);

function frame() {
  sync.update();
  renderer.render(sync.scene, fromTHREECamera(threeCamera));
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
frame();
```

Call `sync.dispose()` and `renderer.dispose()` when finished.

## Common pitfalls

- Material parameter and texture pixel edits need `markUpdated()`. Development builds warn once per material for missing parameter notifications (at most 200 checks per render); override with `validateUpdates`. See [updates](./docs/updates.md#checking-missing-material-notifications).
- Use `geometry.markVerticesUpdated()`, not `markUpdated()`, for vertex animation; neither recomputes normals.
- `createPlaneGeometry()` is 2×2 in XZ; `createSphereGeometry()` and `createCubeGeometry()` span -1..1. Scale with `transform`.
- Rect lights are one-sided; rotate them to face the scene.
- OIDN and HDR output require WebGPU; WebGL 2 denoises with JNLM only.
- Call `renderer.setSize` with drawing-buffer pixels ; camera aspect is automatic unless explicitly set.
- Changing `bvhBuilder`, `bvhLayout` or `bvhSpatialSplits` automatically rebuilds existing static BVHs on the next render.
- In Vite development, add `optimizeDeps: { exclude: ['@meimu/mutracer'] }` so bundled assets load.
